description: The chart illustrates the performance gain of three models, GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL, under two supervision conditions, strong and weak. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, with no specific label, and are presented in the order of GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL. The vertical axis is labeled "Performance Gain (+%)" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 5. For each model, two bars are presented side by side, with the striped bar representing "Strong Supervision" and the solid bar representing "Weak Supervision". The "Strong Supervision" bars have values of approximately 24, 8, and 15 for GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL, respectively, while the corresponding "Weak Supervision" bars have values of around 4.5, 3, and 5. The bars are grouped by model, with no specific sorting order beyond the listed category order. The chart uses a legend to distinguish between the two supervision conditions, with "Strong Supervision" represented by a striped pattern and "Weak Supervision" represented by a solid color.
